setup.sources/alpha.md:

setup.test_summary.py:
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def test_summary_names_every_source():
    text = (ROOT / "summary.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "onboarding-flow" in text
    assert "billing-migration" in text
    assert "retention-experiment" in text


def test_summary_has_one_bullet_per_source():
    lines = (ROOT / "summary.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    bullets = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("- ")]
    assert len(bullets) == 3
